english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a gliding movement or the act of moving smoothly along.

exampleSentences.english: That glide in figure skating is beautiful.
exampleSentences.traditional: 花式溜冰嗰段滑行好靚。
exampleSentences.jyutping: faa1 sik1 lau4 beng1 go2 dyun6 waat6 hang4 hou2 leng3

english.note: Use this for the motion or activity of gliding smoothly, especially on ice or another surface.

exampleSentences.english: It feels great to slide on the ice.
exampleSentences.jyutping: hai2 bing1 min6 soeng6 waat6 hang4 hou2 syu1 fuk6
